steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And eight remain—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: No, remain? Flip that around, almost half the Knights in the field have already exited due to injuries!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Wait—as I was saying that, it looks like 'Hoarhair' has taken a point off 'Springwater'—oh! And 'Drifter' Dorka barges in to pick them off! Now that's what I call productive!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Everyone pulling moves on everyone else—this is the glamor of the Fireblade Melee, folks! 24-carat violence!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Light, heed me—!

steps.name: 'Gałązka' Knight
steps.text: That's all you're capable of? How the hell did you beat Ingra?!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Your swordhand... is nothing compared to my auntie's!

steps.name: 'Gałązka' Knight
steps.text: Heh, I'll tear you right off that scoreboard, 'Nearl!' Watch this!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah—behind you!

steps.name: 'Gałązka' Knight
steps.text: Uagh—?!

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Fancy seeing you again, young Nearl. You've got nowhere to run now.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And right after 'Gałązka' comes 'Flametail'! Whoa, way-way-way, how many times has someone come for the Nascent Nearl now? You gotta get your own show, Maria!

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: God, I hate that guy. You're too loud!

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Anyway, we're running out of foes to fight. Looks like we finally get to size each other up, right?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —If all we're doing is measuring, I'll gladly keep you company.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Ooh. Not bad. Your eyes got a lot better since you messed up Plastic.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Hup—
One blink. Open. Shut.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Below?!)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Gugh—?!

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Ohh? Dodged that, did you?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (What did she do just now...? She wasn't that fast—more like just too dexterous...)

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Ahh. I see how you held up for so long against Ingra and Szewczyk now... you've got a better foundation than I thought.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Whislash taught you all of that, huh?

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Nn-huh. You've got a sharp eye too. You know, you learn pretty quick.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: And now you're down one point. I think me and this format are gonna get along just fine.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Keep on like this, and every point you got from capping Plastic's gonna go down the drain, you know that?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hnnfh—!

steps.name: 'Gałązka' Knight
steps.text: Urrrrraaahhh! You stinking little squirrel—!

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Can't you just lie down and bite it for one second?!

steps.name: 'Gałązka' Knight
steps.text: Hah! Knocked away your weapon! What are you gonna do now, huh?!

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Just pick them back up?! Dumbass!

steps.name: 'Gałązka' Knight
steps.text: Don't waste your breath! You'll meet your end right here!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —Watch out!

steps.name: 'Gałązka' Knight
steps.text: What the hell? Arts—no, you can't be, you're not even armed!

steps.name: 'Gałązka' Knight
steps.text: No, you... you... you can't be—

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Good night.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Jeez, Louise...! What a good day to earn some free points... Alright, where were we, little Nearl?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Here she comes again—!)

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: D'ja know? Fun fact, I'm Infected.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Huh? Infecte—

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: And another point. It is SO easy to distract you.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...But when you said Infected, you weren't just saying it, right?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: You used your Arts directly just now...

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Isn't it a shame?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: You mean?

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: When the Blood Knight took the title, they went 'yeah, we'll officially let Infected be knights'—but when the Radiant Knight got infected, they chased her completely out of Kazimierz. Doesn't that suck?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret...

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Your debut battle was at the Roar Arena, right? All you needed to do was take your paperwork to the Knights Association, sign for your tournament credentials, and then head backstage to gear up...

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Do you know how much—how MUCH—an Infected has to do to get here?

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: They think it's funny to lock you in a cage of gloompincer first. They think it's funny to make you trample the blood of other Infected, leaving one footprint at a time... they make you win back your humanity, to prove you're a normal, living, breathing person.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Welcome to the bottom line. They weren't gonna give the Infected any respect for a single second. 'Just throw them into the machine. Make them one more symbol of our progress.'

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: ...Don't you think I have the right to hate it?

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Our sights are set on every noble knight who thinks her opinion means the world... we'll go under their own rules, cut them right where it hurts.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Honestly, I'm not here to knock you out of the game... after all, I respect the Radiant Knight from the bottom of my heart. Being Infected doesn't sway me there.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Let's call the points I've already taken a fee, and here's a lesson on behalf of 'Whislash.' From the match where you beat Ingra, I can tell you still don't understand what the actual significance of the Major is.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Blind enthusiasm? Riding your own efforts, tuning all the warning signs out? In any ideal scenario, worst is you'd fall flat on your face. But this is the Major. That'll kill you.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Keep it up. Whatever.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Wait.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Light? Same thing as when you beat Ingra...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —Hiyaah!

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Are you kidding?!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: That's one point back, Flametail!

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Goddamn. Didn't think you were so stupid thirsty for it—

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: —But hey, now you look like the Radiant Knight's sister!
We step back, put some distance between us. Our blades face off again.
...This feels strange.
We just talked a little, simple as that. Facing her, I can't feel any of the same immense, nauseating pressure Szewczyk and Ingra had... is it just because of her nature?
Yet she's so strong. Ngh. And fast. And masterful.

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: You're smiling? You're that confident?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Am I?

steps.name: Passing Fan
steps.text: Eh. Give it a try and you'll find out.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Alright, then...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Aaaaaaaand—! Tiiiiiiiime!
We stop in our tracks as soon as we hear the announcer.
By just a hair—by just the slightest hair, we could've been touching the other's armor.
Lightly, like she's just messing with me, 'Flametail' taps against my shield.

steps.name: 'Flametail' Knight
steps.text: Maybe you'd have taken one more point off me here. Maybe not. Who can say, Maria?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Could've been two, maybe.

steps.name: 'Flametail' Knight
steps.text: Hahahaha—you know, from the stands, it's hard to tell just how fiercely stubborn you are, Nearlie.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And our refs are finished judging! At the end of this free-for-all, only four remained standing!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Yo, audience! Here's the deciding moment your wallets have been waiting for! Even if your favorite knight started out getting knocked around six ways from Sunday, don't you lose the light! The Arena's here to welcome you back any time!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Fourth place! Earning ten points, the arena was his to walk, and he avoided almost any direct battle! Our survivor with smarts, 'Gałązka' Daniel!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Third place! Hunted by the whole arena since the word go, and without a moment to breathe, she might be our biggest winner on the points exchange tonight! Our dainty, charming independent knight, Maria Nearl!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Second place! In the starting skirmishes, he beat three knights with his own hands! He made the arena's corner his own with his tremendous shields! The walking fortress, 'Limestone' Marko!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And our champion tonight, with twenty-two fresh points to her name! A near uninterrupted combo of victories! The super-rookie who never drags her feet—'Flametail' Sona!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And that win of hers means a mean mountain of money, so let's make some mega noise—! Coming up! We'll be announcing the lottery draws for each prize pool! Tonight, while the knights strike the sky, the audience strikes it big! All at the Fireblade Arena!

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Ah, welcome, dear Miss.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Having the fortune to meet the youngest ever to join the Kazimierz Armorless Union, the mighty Platinum, I admit that I, humble Czarny, am profoundly terrified.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Uh, can we not with the niceness, Spokesman, sir. You're the ones who yelled for me anyway, right?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Hardly, hardly. I'm merely the General Chamber's mouthpiece, working as its directors will it. How could I dare think to command the mighty Platinum?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You say that, but, like, two of them are just busy and then the three above make everyone else do all the work forever, right?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Ugh, this sucks... I hate overtime. I already had enough work before you called me... Seriously, I wanna go on vacation to Sami once the Major's done.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: As long as the General Chamber agrees, I can arrange you a Sami countryside villa right this moment.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I gotta wait until work's over, thoughhh—

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: —What do you want the Armorless Union to do?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: We have many problems on our hands, dear Miss. Infected out of line, curious rumors, knights drawing a little too much attention...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: But I trust that at the nod of the mighty Platinum of the Armorless Union, none of these will be a problem at all.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I'm back! Where's the chef? Let's get him going!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: He's got a big meal to make tonight, and Maria'll be here soon... she needs a feast and then some! Don't say it was me who called for it.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Madam Zofia, you have a guest. One who claims urgent business with you.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: A guest? Now?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: They can wait until Maria's back—

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ah... apologies, Zofia, for coming uninvited...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You're the one who... *sigh*... I remember you had your own little company, and then you broke into my place like this, thinking you'd make off with all my sponsorship rights.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Well, out with it. What now?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: I, uh, there's some... I have some info here... probably some of it's rumors...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: But don't tell anyone! True or false, the event plans here are all top, top secret...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: But I think you've guessed that already... just treat this as me paying you back... and, uh, I hope things turn out well for you...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: I haven't seen a good knight in a long time... who had a happy ending.
